description:
After the auto-merge hold (#1567 Makefile + PR #1592 workflow arms only on ready_for_review / make pr-ready), a green non-draft non-soundness PR with auto-merge OFF is the normal intentional state while work continues — not a stranding.

`_project/scripts/green_unmerged_sweep.py` still defines stranded as roughly: non-draft ∧ required green ∧ auto-merge off ∧ not soundness ∧ age > threshold. That matches every intentional hold after CI goes green. Nightly green_unmerged_sweep.py --apply (and any re-arm path) then fights the hold: false-positive digests and, if --apply arms, re-introduces the partial-stack race the hold exists to prevent.

Remediation must not claim synchronize re-enables (post-#1592 it only disables for soundness).

Replaces dropped stub green-unmerged-sweep-false-positives-after-auto-merge-hold (promote from deferral #697). Sibling: auto-merge-explicit-hold-is-not-durable. Origin: CI/merge integrity batch residual audit 2026-08-05.
